desc: Deliciously smooth gravy is one stir away with Gold Medal Wondra Quick Mixing All Purpose Flour. This fast-dissolving flour is perfect for making sauces and gravies without lumps. It's also great for baking! Create ultra-flaky pie crusts, fluffy cakes, homemade pastries, and more. This time-saving solution is the perfect ingredient for your mixes. Choose this last-minute, easy fix and make gravy, sauces, and other delicious meals and decadent desserts. Store this in your pantry for any last-minute creations. Gold Medal has over 135 years of baking success. We mill the flour that people rely on to make everything from family favorites to new and inspired creations. We put our best into everything we do - so you can too. Contains Gold Medal Wondra Quick Mixing All Purpose Flour, 13.5 oz; in All Purpose Flours.
features:
PANTRY STAPLE: Our quick-dissolving flour for thickening your sauces and gravies easily

BAKING MADE EASY: This all purpose flour also brings out the best in your baked goods like cakes, cookies, and breads

FRY 'EM UP: Use this flour to create a fine, crispy batter for your meat, fish, and veggies

ENDLESS USES: Rely on this finely ground flour to create everything from deliciously smooth gravy to crackly breads and buns

CONTAINS: Six Gold Medal Wondra Quick Mixing All Purpose Flour, 13.5 oz bag; in All Purpose Flours
ingredients: Bleached Wheat Flour, Niacin (a B vitamin), Iron, Thiamin Mononitrate (Vitamin B1), Riboflavin (Vitamin B2), Folic Acid (a B vitamin).
